arguments.sql: SELECT strftime('%Y-%m', t.date) AS month, 1.0 * SUM(f.is_fraud) / COUNT(*) AS fraud_rate, COUNT(*) AS labelled_transactions, SUM(f.is_fraud) AS fraud_count FROM transactions t JOIN fraud_labels f ON f.transaction_id = CAST(t.id AS TEXT) WHERE t.date >= '2019-01-01' AND t.date < '2019-11-01' GROUP BY strftime('%Y-%m', t.date) ORDER BY month
arguments.explanation: Computes the fraud rate for each month from January to October 2019, using only labelled transactions, along with the labelled count and fraud count behind each rate.
assumptions: Fraud rate is computed over labelled transactions only (inner join to fraud_labels); unlabelled transactions are excluded, not treated as legitimate.
Months are calendar months by transaction date, covering 2019-01-01 through 2019-10-31.
